payload.body_they: {{Name}} is often drawn to people whose confidence, ambition, or sense of direction makes those same qualities easier to recognize in themselves. Admiration can become complicated if the other person's certainty starts carrying more authority than their own judgment. A relationship works better when both people bring a direction of their own, instead of {{Name}} slowly adjusting their life around the future the other person wants.
